title: How to Deploy a Cursor or Claude Code App to Production
summary: Deploy your Cursor or Claude Code app to production: database, auth, and hosting from scratch — or skip all of it with 2 commands.
body_markdown: The fastest path: install the Blink plugin with` npx skills add blink-new/blink-plugin` , then ask your agent to "provision a database on Blink." It creates a Postgres instance, writes the connection string to your secrets manager, and updates your app config — all in one step, without leaving Cursor.
